stories.title: Malicious Virtualizor Update Served via BGP Hijacking
stories.description: Using a technically valid TLS certificate for Softaculous’ domains, a threat actor diverted traffic to fake software updates.

stories.title: Attackers Exploit Two SonicWall SMA 1000 Zero-Days That May Form an Attack Chain
stories.description: SonicWall patches two SMA 1000 flaws after finding evidence they were actively exploited, possibly as a chain for remote code execution.

stories.title: OpenAI’s Astra Becomes First Model to Cross Critical Cybersecurity Threshold
stories.description: The designation applies when a model can independently find and exploit zero-day vulnerabilities across many well-defended systems.

stories.title: Hackers Pose as IT Support on Microsoft Teams to Take Remote Control of Windows PCs
stories.description: Cybercriminals pose as IT support on Teams, abuse Quick Assist, and install malware by tricking employees into granting remote access.

stories.title: Silver Fox-Linked Hackers Use Fake Software Installers to Disable Microsoft Defender and Compromise Windows Systems
stories.description: Silver Fox hackers use fake software installers to breach Windows systems, weaken security, and target organizations across multiple sectors.

stories.title: GeoNetwork Fixes Unauthenticated RCE Chain Affecting Government Geoportal Backends
stories.description: GeoNetwork patched two formatter flaws that can be chained for unauthenticated remote code execution; no in-the-wild exploitation is reported.

stories.title: Chrome and Firefox Updates Patch Dozens of Vulnerabilities
stories.description: The browser refreshes fix multiple use-after-free, sandbox escape, and privilege escalation bugs.

stories.title: Extradited Russian Hacker Faces Charges Over Excel Malware Campaign That Infected Thousands
stories.description: U.S. prosecutors charged a Russian man, alleging a malware campaign sent Excel attachments to about 80,000 freelance platform users.

stories.title: Critical SonicWall Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities Actively Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: SonicWall warned of active exploitation of two critical SMA1000 flaws that could enable unauthorized access and arbitrary OS command execution.

stories.title: 23-Year-Old Sality P2P Botnet Disrupted
stories.description: The shutdown operation involved peer list manipulation and Sality payload URL takedown.

stories.title: Critical HPE Fabric Composer Flaws Let Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code and Take Over Systems
stories.description: HPE patched multiple Fabric Composer flaws that could let unauthenticated attackers gain admin access, execute commands, and fully compromise systems.

stories.title: Researchers Use Claude to Port Pre-Auth RCE Exploit From One PLC Model to Another
stories.description: Researcher-guided Claude ported a pre-authentication RCE exploit to a WAGO 750-831 PLC, executing ARM shellcode on live hardware.

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
